verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail is now part of LegalZoom, described as "America's #1 online legal services company," which implies entity services from the same provider family. The address can also be listed on public records for privacy. However, no evidence explicitly shows LLC formation bundled with the mailbox. Missing for 10: explicit LLC formation offering or bundle, lease-grade addresses for foreign qualification, residency-grade addresses, and documentation of how the address and entity services integrate.
